tracking.tiktok_reason: No usable clickable website/bio link; TikTok is reach/retention/completion/comments/shares/profile-visits only.

measurement.keep: KEEP if Instagram shares/sends rate >= 1.5% OR >= 10 tagged DUFYND sessions with downstream product views; on TikTok also KEEP if 3s retention >= 70% and completion >= 30%, or share/comment response is clearly above the account baseline.
measurement.iterate: ITERATE if retention is healthy but shares/sends or tagged sessions are weak; change only the opening frame or CTA, not the core 1/2/3 style structure.
measurement.kill: KILL only after two hook variants if Instagram shares/sends < 0.5% and tagged sessions < 5, while TikTok 3s retention < 55% and completion < 20%.

required: no PILOT/preview labels
first frame understandable in under 1 second
large safe-zone typography
existing product images only
no claim that any fragrance is universally safe
Instagram has real tracked DUFYND path
TikTok contains no fake link CTA
no price claim
no publish action
